in_sanskrit.name: अम्बु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ambu is derived from the Sanskrit word अम्बु (ambu), which means 'mother'. It is a popular name for girls in India and holds deep significance as it represents the love and nurturing qualities of a mother.

in_marathi.name: Ambu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the name Ambu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amba’ meaning nectar or ‘Amrit’. It is believed that this name was given to the divine mother Goddess Parvati when she was blessed by Lord Shiva with the elixir of immortality.
